method: 60s actual patrol/CCTV sampled2Hz plus 24 cone-aware full-heist runs and36 fixed-route/gait runs per variant (3 gaits ×2 approaches ×2 escapes ×3 delays). Keep-distance bot option is off; replays are proxies, not human success rates. Escape always runs in the fixed-gait runner, so its gait comparison applies to approach only. Existing timer/collision retained.

sameDistanceRisk.assumptions: Constant gait, equal path, same observer/distance/cone/body visibility and no saturation/decay. Algebraic exposure comparison, not a complete detection-time model.
